title: Energy Transition Skills: New Economy Skills Report | World Economic Forum
text: Demand for energy, minerals and other natural resources is rising, while geopolitical tensions and climate risks are placing additional pressure on these systems. More efficient, resilient and sustainable systems are increasingly essential to economic growth and competitiveness. Delivering this transition will depend on people with the skills to make it happen.The fourth installment of the New Economy Skills series examines the skills needed for this transition. Drawing on unique data and insights, the report analyses demand across industries and regions, as well as the readiness of workers and education systems to respond. It finds that demand for transition skills is growing and broadening, but efforts to develop them are insufficient. The report calls for building on workers’ existing skills, bringing education and training closer to real-world demand, and ensuring that organizations of all sizes can access the skills they need.Follow this topic.
